purpose: Add the canonical 13-code Organization Capability Authority as a tenant-scoped PostgreSQL aggregate in shadow mode, with bounded organization-admin mutation and no registration or downstream enforcement change.
requiredInvariants: The vocabulary contains exactly 13 canonical OrganizationCapability codes.
Organization, tenant, membership, role, status and verification class are server-derived; client-supplied authority fields are rejected.
Provider, regulated and integration capabilities declared by an organization remain PENDING_VERIFICATION.
PostgreSQL FORCE RLS denies cross-tenant and cross-organization access.
CAS versioning, advisory serialization and payload-bound idempotency protect every mutation.
Assignment, append-only event, chained audit and outbox rows commit in one transaction.
Auction, Deal, Settlement and role eligibility do not consume this authority in W1-A; enforcementMode is SHADOW.
No capability backfill or default grant is created.
No new mandatory paid dependency or external partner access is introduced.
Shared app.module.ts changes rerun legacy PC-CROP-01B.3 acceptance without assigning that slice ownership of unrelated PR files.
acceptance: GET returns only the current organization registry, assignments and effective ACTIVE codes.
An organization administrator may DECLARE or REVOKE with If-Match and a human reason.
Four non-regulated codes may self-activate; all other declarations remain PENDING_VERIFICATION.
Exact replay returns the original receipt and a changed payload under the same key is rejected.
Concurrent commands using the same expected version produce one commit and one stale-version result.
A forced audit/outbox failure rolls back the assignment and event.
The concurrent-scope guard confirms no registration or role-eligibility path changed.
